name: ComfyUI-InstantHMR (fast 3D human bodies from photo, video or live camera)
summary: ComfyUI node pack for InstantHMR (NaturalPad / LAAS-CNRS): recovers each person's 3D body (pose, shape, 70 2D/3D keypoints, full MHR mesh) from images, video or a live webcam/phone feed at ~2.5 ms per person. Outputs the same MHR body as ComfyUI's SAM 3D Body nodes for smoothing, rendering and animated GLB/BVH export, and can drive Mixamo/VRM characters or stream to Blender via VMC.

publisher.name: jtydhr88 (ComfyUI pack); InstantHMR by NaturalPad / LAAS-CNRS

access.notes: nano/tiny/small/medium weights: non-commercial only. medium_commercial weights allow commercial use under SAM License terms (trade controls, no military use). MHR body model Apache-2.0. Ungated HF downloads.

procedure: Install via ComfyUI Manager or git clone https://github.com/jtydhr88/ComfyUI-InstantHMR into custom_nodes
Download a checkpoint from https://huggingface.co/jtydhr88/ComfyUI-InstantHMR into models/detection (use instanthmr_medium_commercial.safetensors for commercial work)
Export animated GLB/BVH via the native SAM 3D Body nodes

verdict.why: Rechecked after yesterday's deferral: licenses now explicit (code Apache-2.0, weights SAM License, one commercial-OK checkpoint, MHR Apache-2.0). Traction up to 27 stars in a day, launch post ~208 likes; upstream InstantHMR ~298 stars. Fast real-time mocap in ComfyUI.
